items.problem: Threading guidance did not warn that DispatcherQueue is ambiguous when Windows.System remains imported.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3017-3031: CS0104 named Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue and Windows.System.DispatcherQueue; qualification fixed it.
items.proposed_improvement: Add a collision note instructing removal of the unused import or full qualification of Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue.
items.generalizes: Windows.System is common in UWP pages for Launcher and other APIs, so both DispatcherQueue types frequently enter scope after migration.
